reason: The cited evidence (E2) supports that in situ TiC forms and enhances hardness/strength in the baseline alloy, but it does not address irradiation behaviour, defect sink efficiency, or the effect of extra Ti+C additions. The key premises about radiation tolerance and the specific quantitative prediction are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: In situ TiC precipitates form during powder metallurgy of W-based HEAs and enhance hardness/strength
Fine TiC precipitates can act as sinks for irradiation-induced point defects and helium atoms
Dispersion strengthening from TiC can maintain mechanical integrity under irradiation
Adding extra Ti and carbon will produce a uniform, fine dispersion of TiC precipitates
A 30% reduction in radiation-induced hardness increase is achievable via this TiC dispersion
